baseline.scope: Same frame fixtures, one process per variant on the same host. Warmed read-only host-view vs defensive-snapshot microbenchmark, not end-to-end FPS.

optimized.scope: Same frame fixtures, one process per variant on the same host. Warmed read-only host-view vs defensive-snapshot microbenchmark, not end-to-end FPS.
